title: Not fixing data types in Power Query
description_of_error: Setting: The Power Query inside an Excel workbook was reading an external table of numbers and an IF statement assessed if the number was higher that a threshold. Inside the query, the column had the datatype left as "Any". PROBLEM: The external table contained a mixture of numbers and strings where the data was missing. Because Power Query auto-detected datatypes, it sometimes classified the column as "String". The problem was that a string is always evaluated as higher than any number. Ex: "0.01">5000 would evaluate as TRUE.
how_to_prevent_it: Always define the datatype in the Power Query.
